accepted_core_outcome: Veterinary medication inventory: scan bottle barcode to auto-populate drug details into locked template format, allow quantity-on-hand entry that adds to count, support manual entry for unscannable items, and compile multi-phone counts via Excel import/export for final inventory
last_turn_summary: Built full Expo app: scan screen with expo-camera, manual entry with vet domain fidelity (forms, categories, locations), inventory list with search/filter, import/export/merge with XLSX matching exact template columns (only Qty editable concept). Verified gates INSTALL, TYPECHECK, UNIT, COMPONENT, SMOKE (web), A11Y, VISUAL, SEC, PERF. Web preview running on 8081.
